subject: Your thesis is still waiting at 2AM
preview_text: We added something new since you last opened the app. Open it and see what changed.
body_paragraphs: Remember that feeling of staring at a blank page at 2AM, deadline panic creeping in? That's exactly when 90% of our users finally open Thesis Generator and get their thesis done in 10 minutes flat. But you haven't opened it in a while, and something changed since you last did.

We rolled out a new feature that auto-generates graphs, tables, and citations from your thesis draft—no extra work. It's like having a research assistant who never sleeps. Plus, we updated our AI humanizer to bypass Turnitin and GPTZero even better, so you can submit with confidence.
Open the app now and check out the new 'Quick Graph' button in your draft editor. It turns your data into a polished chart in seconds, ready to export to PDF. No extra steps, no waiting.
Tap the button below to open Thesis Generator and see what's new. P.S. Your last draft is still saved—just hit 'Open Draft' and you're back in action.
